fields.label: Authority
fields.help: The :authority header in the gRPC request sent from Envoy to the extension service.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: A human-readable description of the resource.

fields.label: Fail Open
fields.help: Determines how the proxy behaves if the call to the extension fails or times out.

fields.label: Forward Headers
fields.help: List of the HTTP headers to forward to the extension (from the client).

fields.label: Load Balancing Scheme
fields.help: Required when the service points to a backend service.

fields.label: Service
fields.help: The service that runs the extension.

fields.label: Timeout
fields.help: Specifies the timeout for each individual message on the stream.

fields.label: Wire Format
fields.help: The format of communication supported by the callout extension.
